subject: general
question: Since 2004, which of the following states in India is the permanent venue of the International Film Festival of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Goa.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Goa** has been the permanent venue for **IFFI** since** 2004.**
 
• **International Film Festival of India **(IFFI) is an annual film festival organized by the** Ministry of Information and Broadcasting,** Government of India.
 
• The festival was started in **1952** and has been held in different cities across India.
 
• The festival showcases a wide **range of films** from across the world, including feature films, documentaries, and short films.
 
• The festival also includes **panel discussions, workshops, and masterclasses **with industry experts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Under the support of India's first prime minister, the** Films Division** of the Government of India hosted the inaugural edition of IFFI.
 
• The Festival was first held in Mumbai from **January 24 to February 1, 1952,** and it thereafter traveled to **Madras, Delhi, Calcutta, and Trivandrum.**
 
• The** 35th edition **of the International Film Festival of India marked the festival's transition to a permanent location in** Goa** and global competition beginning in **2004.**
 
• Every year, it takes place in the months of **November and December. **
